guitar.notes: Well documented: Martin acoustics for folk era, Fender Stratocaster famously at Newport 1965. Entry is accurate.

tone.summary: A clean, flat signal chain simulating a dry acoustic folk sound using minimal processing and focusing on clarity.
corrections: use acoustic sim or flat clean only

rig.name: Bob Dylan - The Times They Are A-Changin' - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean recordings.

blocks.purpose: Even out the dynamics of fingerpicked acoustic strumming.
blocks.gap: The Comp module is used to simulate the natural compression of a close-mic'd acoustic guitar, as dedicated acoustic preamps are unavailable.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No overdrive or distortion is required for a dry folk sound.
Provide a clean, non-colored foundation suitable for acoustic simulation.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is chosen as the cleanest available amp model to minimize coloration and mimic a flat recording environment. True acoustic modeling is absent.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the sound of a close-mic'd acoustic source.
blocks.gap: The US 2x12 is selected for its clean, articulate tone, best suited for capturing the detail of fingerpicking. A dedicated acoustic IR would be ideal.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the clarity and definition of the acoustic guitar's fundamental frequencies.
blocks.gap: Manual EQ shaping is necessary to compensate for the lack of a dedicated acoustic tone control, focusing on high-end sparkle and low-mid punch.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No filtering or sweeping effects are needed.
Bypass. Chorus and Tremolo are explicitly avoided.
Add subtle depth and space without sounding like a noticeable echo.
blocks.gap: Used minimally to simulate the natural decay of sound in a large, non-studio environment, keeping it extremely subtle.

blocks.purpose: Provide minimal, natural room ambience without sounding artificial or heavy.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is used with extremely low settings to mimic the subtle reflections of a large hall, adhering to the 'minimal room ambience' requirement.

improvements.summary: Replace the generic IR with an acoustic or flat recording space simulation to better match the dry, close-mic studio sound.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Close-Mic Acoustic Room IR (or Flat Studio IR)
proposals.reason: The current US 2x12 is too 'ampy' for a dry, close-mic studio sound.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased realism and clarity of the acoustic source.
